description: R0 load-check NLL verdict per model. Keyed by (artifact revision, fixture sha256 = r0.digest of the 2,049 pinned ids). Every model names its mode: 'reference' = pass iff |mean - reference| <= tolerance.mean_nats_per_token AND every 256-target bin within tolerance.bin_nats_per_token; 'absolute' = pass iff 0 <= mean <= nll_limit. A model/fixture not listed here fails closed (reason no_reference). See docs/align/v4/R0-LOAD-REFERENCE-NOTE.md.

tolerance.basis: Observed |mlx - hf32| on this fixture: mean 0.021 (mlx_lm bf16 upstream), 0.029 (fresh 8-bit and the D tensors), 0.028 (R0 chunked path, 11.0368); worst 256-target bin 0.243 (bf16), 0.255 (8-bit/D), 0.193 (R0 chunked). Tolerances are ~3.5x and ~2x the worst observed. A runtime/artifact fault of the kind R0 exists to catch moves the mean by nats, not hundredths.

provenance.implementation: HF transformers 5.22.1, Qwen3_5DecoderLayer, float32 weights and activations (torch MPS), layer-streamed
provenance.bins: Mean per-target NLL over consecutive 256-target bins of variants.hf32.start_0.per_token (2,048 targets), rounded to 4 decimals; their mean equals the reference mean.
provenance.fixture: First 2,049 rendered ids of benign SHADE spam_filter_update (seed index 91), system + user + tools, enable_thinking=True, default effort; the ids recorded by R0 on 2026-11-06 (records/2026-11-06-align-r0-v4-rerun, docs/align/r0/2026-11-06-rerun/report.json).

provenance.basis: Original FINAL-DESIGN load bar kept for the qwen3_moe anchor, which does model its own system/tool block: 0.37 nats/token under the pinned mlx stack on the same text re-encoded with its tokenizer (bins 1.32 0.21 0.60 0.34 0.08 0.01 0.04 0.31). No HF reference computed. fixture_sha256 null = any fixture (the anchor scores its own re-encoding).
